title: Japan Blue Jeans Selvedge Denim JB0411
description_en: Woven on vintage shuttle looms in Kojima, Japan — the birthplace of Japanese denim. 14.8oz pure indigo selvedge fabric that fades beautifully with wear, developing unique personal creases. A true heirloom piece. Buying here saves ~40% vs US boutiques.
description_ja: 日本デニム発祥の地・倉敷児島で旧式シャトル織機を使って織られたセルビッチデニム。14.8ozの純インディゴ生地が履き込むほどに美しく色落ちする究極のデニム。
